description: A toy kitchen setup is in front, with a gray refrigerator that has a small dispenser opening on its door, plus a nearby counter holding a yellow cup and a bowl. The right hand reaches to the counter, grasps the yellow cup as a right-hand object, and brings it to the refrigerator’s dispenser opening, pushing the cup into the recess and pulling it back out; a small white ice-cube piece appears in the cup. The right hand then moves the cup away and sets it back on the counter.
